alignment: non-overlapping logical-recording multiples of 300; no joining partial file boundaries
coverage: 300 observed normal-phase seconds from non-overlapping complete mouse bins, including stationary bins; 0.00001 second total rounding tolerance
calculation: each count or sum times 60 / observed seconds, rounded to float32 then stored as Double
keys: key_down plus delete_down including repeats; deletes are not counted twice
mouse: screen-coordinate points and observed movement callback counts; not physical distance
imputation: none; insufficient coverage excludes the window, not zero activity
selection: development-only standardized K-means, development silhouette; smaller k wins ties
stable_ids: centroid lexicographic order within one model version; meanings not assumed stable after retraining
